BiblicalUsage: Jattir was a town in the hill country of Judah, given to the sons of Aaron with its suburbs. David sent spoil to the elders of Jattir after he recovered all from the Amalekites, and the town stands in the list of the priestly cities.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God gives His priests towns as well as tithes, and Jattir was a home for those who served the altar.
